provider.title: Welcome to ExtrAct
provider.subtitle: Choose the AI provider you prefer for transcription. You can always change it later in Settings.

anthropic.title: Anthropic (Claude)
anthropic.description: Recommended for old documents, handwriting, and complex layouts. Slightly more expensive but more faithful to the source text.

openai.title: OpenAI (GPT)
openai.description: Ideal for clean, modern printed documents. Faster and a bit cheaper at similar quality.

apiKey.title: Configure your {{provider}} key
apiKey.subtitle: When you launch a transcription, ExtrAct sends every zone you've cropped to <bold>{{provider}}</bold>'s AI, which reads the image and returns the text. The key below identifies your account with them. You pay {{provider}} directly, on consumption, a few cents per document.
apiKey.privacyNote: Your key is stored <bold>only on your computer</bold>. ExtrAct only sends it to {{provider}} at transcription time, and takes no cut of your usage.
anthropicSteps: Create an Anthropic account (or sign in if you already have one).
Under Plans & Billing, add credit. $5 to $10 is enough to start — you only pay for what you use.
Under API Keys, click Create Key, copy the key, and paste it below.
openaiSteps: Create an OpenAI account (or sign in if you already have one).
Under Billing, add credit. $5 to $10 is enough to start — you only pay for what you use.
Under API keys, click Create new secret key, copy the key, and paste it below.

privacy.title: Help us fix bugs?
privacy.subtitle: ExtrAct can automatically send a report when the app crashes, so we can fix bugs we'd otherwise miss. Your choice is 100% respected and can be changed any time in Settings.
privacy.includedTitle: If you opt in, here's what gets sent on a crash
included: The error message and call stack (where in the code the crash happened).
The version of ExtrAct and your system's version (Windows / macOS).
A handful of actions performed just before the crash (clicks, navigation) to help reproduce the bug.
excluded: The contents of your PDFs, your transcriptions, your fields.
Your IP address, your username, your file paths.
privacy.note: Note: ExtrAct of course sends your PDF zones to OpenAI or Anthropic when you launch a transcription — that's how the app works. This question only covers the error reports we use to fix bugs, which is a separate thing.
privacy.recipient: <bold>Recipient:</bold> Sentry, servers in Germany (European Union, GDPR).
